title: James Randi's spoon and watch trick in front of Svahn
summary: Clas Svahn tells of James Randi's spoon and watch trick in front of Svahn, about an unknown time at an unknown place, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And he he bent his spoon in front of me.

plain: Clas Svahn, a researcher, says a performer named James Randi once bent a spoon right in front of him and also did a trick with a watch. Svahn tells it to show how convincing such a trick can look up close.
